title: Implement bounded repetitions and failure-preserving summaries
goal: Execute the agreed comparison protocol without losing failures, identity or unknown telemetry
acceptance: Implement reviewed repeat accounting and compatible comparison separation/rejection
Preserve failed/error/not-run outcomes, cold/warm latency and measured input/output/cache provenance
Keep structural and semantic outcomes separate and avoid duplicate source-event token totals
privacy: Repository-owned neutral fixtures only. No real model calls, downloads, secrets, private transcripts or consumer implementation.
validation: Bounded comparison join preserves full requested and observed identity, repeat/result identities, outcome counts and unknown cache coverage across candidate configuration differences
Explicit environment mismatch reason prevents silent comparison while failures remain visible
Typecheck, deterministic tests, build, generated capability index and final required CI; actual model qualification is separately scoped
escalation: Material scope/effort expansion or distinct outcome split requires owner agreement
No real-model campaign, installation or consumer-dependent release gate

effort.estimate: Merged CI verification and reconciliation only
effort.basis: Bounded identity-rich summaries, mismatch reasons and failure/unknown preservation are implemented; exact merged CI remains.
